config.defaultZoomValue: Default zoom level when opening a PDF.
config.sidebarViewOnLoad: Sidebar panel to show when opening a PDF.
config.baseUrl: Address of the OpenAI-compatible translation API (without `/chat/completions`). For a local Ollama use `http://localhost:11434/v1`.
config.temperature: Translation temperature. Lower values keep terminology more consistent.
config.requestTimeout: Timeout of a single request, in milliseconds.
config.maxCharsPerRequest: Maximum number of source characters per request; a paragraph is kept in one request when possible.
config.targetLanguage: Language of the translations. `auto` follows the VS Code display language (English if it is not supported). Changing it re-translates open papers.
config.targetLanguage.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (English if unsupported)
config.sourceLanguage: Language of the papers. `auto` detects it for each sentence; set a language if detection fails on your papers.
config.sourceLanguage.auto: Detect the language of each sentence
config.glossary: Glossary: source term → preferred translation. Plain entries apply to every language, e.g. `{"attention": "注意力"}`; entries under a language code apply to that language only and take precedence, e.g. `{"ja": {"attention": "アテンション"}}`. Changing it re-translates the affected sentences.
config.translateRange: What to translate automatically while reading.
config.translateRange.nearby: The current page and the pages before and after it
config.translateRange.manual: Only on click or through commands
config.cacheDir: Custom directory for the translation cache; empty to use the extension's global storage.
config.extraBody: Extra fields added to the request body. By default it turns off DeepSeek's thinking mode; set it to `{}` for other services.
config.selectOnHover: Select a sentence when the pointer rests on it (highlight, arrow and aligned translation). When off, only clicks select.
